title: A heredoc fed to a shell inside a compound command or backtick is not read as code
detail:
From heredocs-read-as-bash (v0.238.5), checked against real bash 3.2. Each runs its body and the gate reads none of it: '{ bash; } <<EOF', 'while true; do bash; break; done <<EOF', and a shell in a backtick span, 'echo `bash <<B
rm a
B
`', since _command_starts has no backtick start. Data flowing into code is the same class: eval "$(cat <<EOF ...)", bash -c "$(cat <<'EOF' ...)", sh < <(cat <<EOF ...), source /dev/stdin <<EOF. _shell_reads_body only sees the operator's own command word and a pipe to a shell on its line.
